title: Overeenstemmingsmaten voor nominale data 1981-1982
authors: Popping, R., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Sociologisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: To find factors which influence the reliability of coded answers to open questions. Number of categories allowed to use / information about research from which question to be coded was obtained / information about coding by other experts / approach and criteria used for coding / revising categories and restart of coding / measures of agreement. Background variables: basic characteristics/ education
